title: Neptune (Varuna) and Grace
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 24 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Neptune as the giver of grace, its sign and house results, forgiveness, the Bokoju story and Q&A.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 24, Planet Neptune (Varuna) by Brajesh Gautam: grace, intuition, houses 1 to 12, signs, puja, Q&A, with video timestamps.
points: Neptune is the planet of grace.
The sea gives intuition, treasure and manifestation, and it also takes. Which one you get depends on your inner state.
Where it sits, it is limitless and false.
That house is vast but unreal: the result is hard to see, so do not chase understanding.
Asking once and letting go works. Grudges bring the lower sea, and forgiving brings the upper.
Movable, fixed and dual signs set how Neptune acts. It stays about 14 years in one sign.
Each house has its own pattern.
From low self-worth in the 1st to money coming through expenses in the 12th.
Rehearsing a wish or a fear cancels it. Think once and drop it.
Only the aquamarine and a few habits are given here. Most remedies are deferred.
